ThemeImageDescription: Your picture with time, date and weather on top

StocksHint: Add up to five, each with its own show/hide switch (keep at least two). Supports A-shares (600519.SS), Hong Kong (0700.HK) and US (AAPL) on Tencent/Yahoo, and crypto pairs (BTCUSDT) on the Binance source; BTC-USD also works via Yahoo. With exactly two enabled you get a five-day trend comparison. Data may be delayed or inaccurate and is not investment advice.
StocksSourceHint: Tencent works inside mainland China, Yahoo needs international access, Binance covers crypto pairs.
TokscaleLocalOnlyHint: KSS only calls Tokscale's JSON commands on this machine. It does not take over account sign-in, does not read API keys, and never uploads usage or credentials.

TokscaleStep2Hint: After installing, run tokscale once in a terminal
TokscaleStep3: Come back to KSS and check again

RiskStocksBody: Stock, fund and digital-asset quotes come from third-party public endpoints and may be delayed, inaccurate, interrupted, or mapped to the wrong symbol. What you see is for on-screen display only and is not investment advice or a basis for trading.
RiskAiBody: This feature relies on Tokscale, an open-source tool you install yourself. KSS only calls Tokscale's JSON commands locally: it does not take over account sign-in, does not read API keys, and never uploads usage or credentials. How complete the numbers are varies by client and platform, so treat them as personal information display only.

ClaudeSessionKeyHint: Open claude.ai signed in, copy the sessionKey cookie and paste it here. It is stored on this machine and sent to claude.ai only.
ClaudeModelScopeHint: Whose weekly window the third meter shows.
ClaudeCountTokensHint: Sums the Claude Code transcripts on this computer. A floor on real usage, never the account total.
RiskClaudeBody: This reads your limits from claude.ai with a session cookie you paste in yourself. The key is kept in this machine's settings file as plain text and is sent to claude.ai and nowhere else - treat it like a password, and clear it if anyone else uses this computer. The usage endpoint is unofficial and can change or stop working without notice. Token counts come from the Claude Code transcripts on this computer only, so they are a floor on your real usage, not your account total.
ClaudeGuideHeading: Where to find the key - three steps
ClaudeGuideStep2: Press F12 and find the cookies
ClaudeGuideStep3: Copy the sessionKey value and paste it above
